name: phantomtrace-demo-video
description: Remotion project for the PhantomTrace Kiroween 2026 demo video. Separate from the Swift package; the app has no Node dependency.

scripts.thumbnail: npm run sync && remotion still src/index.ts Thumbnail out/thumbnail.png --frame=0 && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i out/thumbnail.png -vf scale=1280:720 -q:v 3 out/thumbnail.jpg
scripts.studio: npm run sync && remotion studio src/index.ts
scripts.render: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts Demo out/phantomtrace-demo.mp4
scripts.render:scene: npm run sync && remotion render src/index.ts
